story_type: basket hoist from a fishing boat pitching in gray Atlantic seas, swimmer rides up last (hoist cam)
hook: 65 miles out, a basket over a pitching fishing boat.
narration: Sixty five miles out in the Atlantic, this basket swung over a pitching fishing boat.
A forty seven year old crewman on the Braedon Michael needed help, south of Montauk, New York.
A Jayhawk crew from Air Station Cape Cod lowered a rescue swimmer onto the deck.
The basket touches the deck before anyone grabs it. That lets static from the rotors discharge into the boat.
The boat kept rolling while they loaded him in.
Then the swimmer rode the cable up last.
outcome: The crewman was hoisted safely and flown to Air Station Cape Cod, where medics were waiting.

location_card.place: 65 miles south of Montauk, New York

title: Basket over a pitching boat, 65 miles out
description:
In April 2017, a Coast Guard Jayhawk crew from Air Station Cape Cod medically evacuated a 47-year-old crewman from the fishing boat Braedon Michael about 65 miles south of Montauk, New York. He was hoisted safely and flown to Air Station Cape Cod, where emergency medical services were waiting.
